text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both treading water with minor overnight declines, while the Fear & Greed index sits deep in greed territory and has climbed sharply over the past week—signaling sustained bullish conviction despite the flat price action. Bitcoin's dominance has risen to 58.7%, suggesting capital is rotating toward the largest asset rather than flowing into alts. Volume remains solid at $121B, indicating there's active participation behind these levels rather than apathy.
